data.name: Reficia: The WonderLog ~3 Days of Whirling Whimsy~
data.detailed_description:
Skill growth shifts your strategy. A 2.5D Action RPG focused on deep character building.

Reficia is a 2.5D action RPG that merges deep, individual skill progression with the high-stakes tension of a run-based challenge. Forget traditional character levels. In this world, your power is defined by the specific weapons, magic, and abilities you actually use.

■ Pure Skill-Based Progression: Grow by Doing

In Reficia, there is no overall "character level." Instead, your growth is driven by the mastery of individual skills.

  • Diverse Skill Sets: From weapons like swords and spears to elemental and restoration magic—even core stats like Strength and Vitality—every action you take earns experience for that specific skill.

  • Meaningful Choices: With a cap on your total skill points, you must decide whether to become a versatile jack-of-all-trades or a specialized master of one. How you allocate your limited resources is the key to conquering the trials ahead.

■ "One-of-a-Kind" Strategy via Random Drops

Unpredictable loot drops will shift your strategy on the fly. When you find powerful equipment, you must decide in an instant which skills to hone to match your new gear. Discover lethal synergies between your evolving skills and random drops to forge a truly unique build for every run.

■ A Three-Day Journey Toward the Final Battle

Your journey is a race against time, spanning just three days. During the day, you can explore relentlessly, even if you fall in battle. However, if you are defeated by the boss waiting at the end of the day, your journey ends there. Sharpen your skills without fear of failure, experiment with unknown drops, and face the destiny that awaits at the end of the third day.

Experience the tactical depth of free-form skill progression, the thrill of random drops, and the tension of a reset-based challenge. Discover your own unique path in this character-building focused Action RPG.

Train weapons and magic to forge unique builds and discover lethal synergies, all while facing the ultimate trial at the end of a 3-day journey.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 7335U / Intel Core i5-1235U or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon 660M / Intel Iris Xe Graphics or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
